title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Prince
desc: A teacher becomes smitten with his British colleague. However, their relationship is soon tested by unforeseen challenges.

title: Saattai
desc: Dayalan, a teacher, tries to change the ongoing malpractices in a government school. Unfortunately, his acts are not welcomed by a few senior members and students, which leads to a rift between them.

title: Bhai
desc: A ruthless crime lord's plan to eliminate a police officer backfires when the henchman assigned to kill him discovers the target is his long-lost brother.

title: Thuparivaalan
desc: An experienced detective investigates the death of a child's pet dog and inadvertently unravels a sinister web of unsolved murders.

title: Kalki
desc: A diligent cop, Kalki, takes on the case of Sekhar's murder in Kollapuram, a village ruled by his powerful brother, Narsappa.

title: Ism
desc: While doing his mission to eradicate corruption, an undercover journalist experiences a forbidden relationship when he falls in love with a high-profile gangster's daughter.

title: Katrathu Kalavu
desc: A boy and a girl, who want to earn quick money, meet and decide to con people for a living. Things change when a politician that they are blackmailing decides to settle scores.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Arjun
desc: Arjun must protect his twin sister from her in-laws who want to kill her.

title: Lucky Man
desc: An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.

title: Naan Sigappu Manithan
desc: After his lover is brutally attacked and left in a coma, Indhiran, who suffers from narcolepsy, becomes a vigilante to take revenge.

title: Kalvan
desc: Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.

title: Noodles
desc: When Harish and Sheela, a married couple, have a disagreement with a local inspector, the situation spirals out of control, leading them to confront Madhan, the officer assigned to their case.

title: Sivanudukkai
desc: A boy becomes an atheist after his parents' death. Unbeknown to him, he is born for a divine purpose and must stop a demon from sacrificing his lover.

title: Maapillai Seenu
desc: Seenu's debt-driven escape to Dubai accidentally reroutes him to Hyderabad. Upon arrival, a shocking discovery leads him to orchestrate a cunning plan.
